newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil tax receipts on imports up 9.1 pct Sept-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil tax receipts on imports up 9.1 pct Sept-Oct.

text.p: Taxes collected by Brazil on imports rose 9.1 percent in October from September, the Internal Revenue Service said.
The Internal Revenue Service said in a statement that tax revenue on oil imports dropped 20.48 percent, but that on other goods it rose 15.31 percent.
It said import taxes totalled 427.3 million reais in October versus 391.7 million reais in September.

Taxes on petrol imports in October were 54.1 million reais versus 68 million reais in September, while taxes on other imported goods were 373.3 million reais in October against 323.7 million reais in September.

The Ministry of Industry and Commerce was due to announce October's trade balance next week. Market expectations put the month's likely deficit as high as $1.0 billion, after a $655 million gap in September.
